dialogue.text: Good morning, Adrian. Melissa Goh speaking. Nice to hear from you. Are you somewhere you can speak privately?

dialogue.text: Certainly. We can keep the conversation focused. Before we get into it, let's do the identity checks. Please have your own details ready.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. No need to rush through the paperwork. I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll let you finish speaking before I take you through the remaining points.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My notes show an earlier investment contribution of 750,000 Chinese yuan; that's historical, not the amount for this disposal. dialogue.text: The transaction charge for this disposal is 0.25%. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and disposing of your holding may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss crystallised by this disposal?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to bear that loss rather than keep the credit exposure. Sorry if I sound distracted. Managing the family business means people are always knocking on the door, even when I've blocked out time for a call.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: No problem. I'll keep to the points we need to cover. I recommend reducing your holding in Orion Global Income Fund because it reduces your exposure to bond credit and interest-rate risks and releases proceeds for your business liquidity needs.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks. Telephone contact is still the easiest way to reach me. If I'm with the warehouse team, I may miss the first ring, but I'll call back when I'm somewhere quiet.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note your contact preference. Please explicitly confirm that the final disposal instruction you've given is what you want me to submit.

dialogue.text: Mm, okay, someone from the office is calling me. dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That information needs internal review. I won't take any processing action during this call. I'll refer the matter to the appropriate team and contact you separately. You can return to your meeting.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: All right, Melissa. Please use the telephone when you need to reach me. I need to go now. Bye.
